metadata.description: Primary-source catalog for resilience engineering: deadlines, retries, hedging, overload protection, chaos testing, mesh policies, resilience telemetry, SLO-as-code, and AI/LLM failure modes.
metadata.title: QA Resilience - Sources

reliability_foundations.name: AWS Well-Architected - Reliability Pillar
reliability_foundations.relevance: Primary source for failure isolation, recovery, and reliability design principles.

reliability_foundations.name: Google SRE Book - Embracing Risk
reliability_foundations.relevance: Foundational framing for SLOs, error budgets, and reliability tradeoffs.

reliability_foundations.name: Google SRE Book - Handling Overload
reliability_foundations.relevance: Primary source for overload behavior, admission control, and graceful rejection.

reliability_foundations.name: Google SRE Book - Addressing Cascading Failures
reliability_foundations.relevance: Primary source for retries, backoff, fail-fast behavior, and anti-amplification patterns.

reliability_foundations.name: Google SRE Workbook - Alerting on SLOs
reliability_foundations.relevance: Primary source for multi-window burn-rate alerting and release or ops guardrails.

reliability_foundations.name: Bronson, Aghayev, Charapko, Zhu - Metastable Failures in Distributed Systems (HotOS 2021)
reliability_foundations.relevance: Defines the metastable-failure class (self-sustaining feedback loops that outlive their trigger) distinct from ordinary cascading failures; foundational reading for cascading-failure-prevention.md's metastable-failures section. Verified real and publicly available 2026-07-11.

rpc_and_client_resilience.name: gRPC Deadlines Guide
rpc_and_client_resilience.relevance: Primary source for deadline propagation and timeout ownership across RPC boundaries.

rpc_and_client_resilience.name: gRPC Retry Guide
rpc_and_client_resilience.relevance: Primary source for retry policy, retry throttling, and retry observability in gRPC.

rpc_and_client_resilience.name: gRPC Request Hedging Guide
rpc_and_client_resilience.relevance: Primary source for when and how to use hedging to reduce tail latency safely.

rpc_and_client_resilience.name: Microsoft .NET HTTP Resilience
rpc_and_client_resilience.relevance: Primary source for modern .NET resilience handlers and shared outbound HTTP policy composition.

rpc_and_client_resilience.name: Polly Documentation
rpc_and_client_resilience.relevance: Primary source for resilience pipeline concepts including timeout, retry, breaker, rate limiting, and hedging.

patterns_and_specs.name: Martin Fowler - Circuit Breaker
patterns_and_specs.relevance: Canonical pattern description for circuit breakers.

patterns_and_specs.name: Microsoft Azure Architecture - Retry Pattern
patterns_and_specs.relevance: Retry guidance for transient failures, backoff, jitter, and idempotency.

patterns_and_specs.name: Microsoft Azure Architecture - Circuit Breaker Pattern
patterns_and_specs.relevance: Circuit breaker guidance for preventing cascading failures.

patterns_and_specs.name: Microsoft Azure Architecture - Bulkhead Pattern
patterns_and_specs.relevance: Bulkhead guidance for isolation and resource exhaustion prevention.

patterns_and_specs.name: Resilience4j Documentation
patterns_and_specs.relevance: Primary Java reference for circuit breaker, retry, bulkhead, rate limiter, and time limiter patterns.

patterns_and_specs.name: Michael T. Nygard - Release It! (2nd ed.)
patterns_and_specs.relevance: Origin source for the stability-patterns vocabulary this skill builds on (circuit breaker, bulkhead, timeouts, fail fast, steady state). Author and title verified 2026-07-11.

gateway_and_mesh.name: Envoy Adaptive Concurrency Filter
gateway_and_mesh.relevance: Primary source for adaptive concurrency and latency-based load protection in shared infrastructure.

gateway_and_mesh.name: Envoy Outlier Detection
gateway_and_mesh.relevance: Primary source for passive health, endpoint ejection, and bad-host containment.

chaos_engineering.name: Principles of Chaos Engineering
chaos_engineering.relevance: Core chaos methodology: steady state, hypothesis, experiment design, and safe execution.

chaos_engineering.name: AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS)
chaos_engineering.relevance: Managed chaos engineering service with guardrails and experiment templates. Supports EC2, ECS, EKS pod-level faults (via ephemeral containers), RDS/Aurora failover, network latency on VPC subnets, and the AZ Power Interruption scenario for full AZ-failure simulation including ARC Zonal Autoshift integration.

chaos_engineering.name: Azure Chaos Studio
chaos_engineering.relevance: Managed chaos engineering for Azure workloads and fault experiments. Core experiment service is GA. Chaos Studio Workspaces (scenario catalog with zone/region-failure templates, drag-and-drop Scenario Designer) entered public preview 2026-07-01 -- treat Workspaces-specific claims as preview-stage.

chaos_engineering.name: Chaos Toolkit Documentation
chaos_engineering.relevance: Open-source experiment framework for deterministic and staged resilience testing.

chaos_engineering.name: LitmusChaos Documentation
chaos_engineering.relevance: Kubernetes-native chaos workflows and experiments, CNCF Incubating project (active, not archived). Helm is the recommended installation method; the legacy litmus-operator-v3.0.0.yaml approach is no longer maintained. Point-release number changes frequently and conflicting values were seen across sources on 2026-07-11 (3.2x range) -- verify the exact current release at github.com/litmuschaos/litmus/releases rather than trusting a pinned number.

chaos_engineering.name: Shopify Toxiproxy
chaos_engineering.relevance: TCP proxy for deterministic fault injection (latency, bandwidth, resets) in integration and CI tests. Latest release: v2.12.0 (March 2025).

chaos_engineering.name: Chaos Mesh Documentation
chaos_engineering.relevance: CNCF Kubernetes chaos engineering platform using CRDs for network, pod, and stress faults.

chaos_engineering.name: LitmusChaos Home
chaos_engineering.relevance: CNCF Kubernetes chaos engineering with a pre-built experiment hub and GameDay workflow engine.

chaos_engineering.name: Gremlin Documentation
chaos_engineering.relevance: Commercial chaos engineering platform with UI, RBAC, audit logs, and pre-built scenario library. 2025 additions: Failure Flags by proxy (no-code sidecar), Reliability Intelligence (AI-powered experiment analysis), Private Edition (self-hosted), .NET Failure Flags SDK.

chaos_engineering.name: Gremlin Failure Flags
chaos_engineering.relevance: Application-level fault injection without infrastructure changes. Use SDK integration or a no-code sidecar proxy to inject latency, exceptions, and custom behaviors at named points in application code. Supports Go, Node, Python, Java, .NET (2025). No-ops when no experiment is active.

chaos_engineering.name: Steadybit Documentation
chaos_engineering.relevance: Modern resilience experimentation platform and safe rollout guidance.

kubernetes_and_platform.name: Kubernetes - Liveness, Readiness, Startup Probes
kubernetes_and_platform.relevance: Primary source for probe behavior and configuration in resilient deployments.

telemetry_and_semantics.name: OpenTelemetry HTTP Semantic Conventions
telemetry_and_semantics.relevance: Primary source for HTTP telemetry naming including server/client attributes and error semantics.

optional_ai_automation.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
optional_ai_automation.relevance: Optional governance baseline when using AI to generate scenarios or summarize resilience test results.

slo_as_code.name: OpenSLO Specification
slo_as_code.relevance: Vendor-agnostic open specification for declaring SLOs and error budgets in version-controlled YAML (openslo/v1 API). Enables SLO-as-code workflows with CI validation via the oslo CLI.

slo_as_code.name: Sloth - Prometheus SLO Generator
slo_as_code.relevance: Generates Prometheus SLI recording rules and multi-window multi-burn-rate alert rules from a simple SLO spec. Supports OpenSLO input and Kubernetes via Prometheus Operator CRDs. v0.16.0 released April 2026.

slo_as_code.name: Pyrra - SLO Management for Prometheus
slo_as_code.relevance: Kubernetes-native SLO management: watches SLO CRD resources, generates Prometheus recording rules, provides UI for error budgets and burn rates. v0.10.0 released April 2026.
